verdict.rationale: Elicit is a SaaS research platform with an API, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis to judge. The evidence shows no registrable HTTP callbacks for programmatic consumers. The only event-style features are instant email alerts and Routines, which are adjacent notification features, not webhooks. The API and MCP server are request-driven access, not event subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
